Theseus reviews its own pull requests with a pinned release: .github/theseus-lock.json is v0.2.4 (source_commit 8635dc71) and both callers (.github/workflows/review-verdict.yml, review-gate.yml) use @8635dc7. The jump from v0.2.4 brings every intervening change (classifier, protocol, evals, legacy removal, v0.2.7 multi-base gating, oracle mirror removal, guidance reader): check the Theseus main ruleset still requires only contexts the new release posts, and that the callers pass every input and secret the release's reusable workflows declare as required.
Decision gate: this lands before the BenchBox v0.2.11 lock is armed; its first reviewed PR (#61) is the rehearsal.
Rollback: revert PR (its review runs under v0.2.11; a broken gate needs an owner stand-in, report it).
Guardrails: G7 in full (hosted SHIP + green checks + independent review of the exact final head); no ruleset change without before/after captures; no owner-only actions; no live model calls; no force push.
